prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a single production-quality mobile app screen concept, exact canvas 390 x 844 portrait, natural ratio.
Primary request: Design the hero screen for LT Share on X, a mobile web app for attendees at Japanese developer lightning-talk events. The screen shows the current post draft, the 3rd LT of the evening, immediately after a photo was recorded and the AI text was generated. Direction: venue-dark-capture — camera-forward dark UI for a dim event venue.
Scene/backdrop: app content only, full-screen mobile layout, no device frame.
Subject: focused draft screen with a large recorded-media preview at the top showing a realistic conference projector slide titled RustでつくるCLI; include a small saved badge 端末に保存済み. Include a large round camera record action 記録する and a small 写真/動画 switch near it. Below, show the generated text, then the developer toggle, then the primary post action.
Style/medium: realistic, production-quality mobile UI mockup; charcoal / near-black surfaces, one electric-blue accent, strong Japanese typography, generous spacing, crisp hierarchy, subtle depth.
Composition/framing: header with app name LT Share on X, draft position 3本目, editable persistent event hashtag #TechLTNight, and 次の投稿へ in the top bar. Large media preview at top. Place the big round 記録する camera button prominently over or just below the media area. Generated post text below exactly: RustでCLIツールを作るLT。clapで引数処理を書き、cargo-distで配布まで自動化する流れを紹介。小さく作って早く配る実践例として参考になる。 Add small caption ChatGPTで生成. Show toggle row currently OFF labeled exactly 開発者をポストに含める. At the bottom, a full-width white pill button labeled exactly ポスト確認.
Text (verbatim): LT Share on X, #TechLTNight, 3本目, 記録する, 写真, 動画, RustでつくるCLI, 端末に保存済み, RustでCLIツールを作るLT。clapで引数処理を書き、cargo-distで配布まで自動化する流れを紹介。小さく作って早く配る実践例として参考になる。, ChatGPTで生成, 開発者をポストに含める, ポスト確認, 次の投稿へ.
Constraints: exactly one mobile screen; all Japanese text must be accurate and legible; body text 14–16px equivalent; at most two fonts; no clipped content; no cards inside cards; no centered app-card on contrasting page background; one clear primary action; if a date/time appears use Friday evening 2026-10-09 around 19:40.
Avoid: do not use the label 投稿済み; do not draw the official X logo or Twitter bird; plain text X only; no developer @account search UI; no device bezel, phone body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock, signal/battery icons, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask, or device shadow; no extra invented features; no watermark.
